column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: 模型為選用項目，完全在本機執行。下載時會從 Hugging Face 取得模型檔案，絕不會上傳任何影像或文件。未安裝模型時，「選取主體」「移除背景」和「移除主體」使用內建的非 AI 方法。
模型下載工作執行緒失敗。
